answer: Ash poles lean against the ladder-maker wall, straight and free of knots. Proof of ladder-maker via rung ladder tally — a ladder the ladder-maker rungs only after 277 ladders stand true without one rung slipping at the joint, each runged by the ladder-maker himself. fable bores the rung holes true and sets them even down the rails. sonnet shapes each rung on the lathe and taps it home with the mallet. marble pegs the rungs fast and tests the ladder. Two hundred and seventy-seven ladders must stand true without one rung slipping at the joint, and the next still slips where the ash ran soft.
